show.name: MTV Hustle
show.tagline: India's biggest hip hop reality competition.
show.about: MTV Hustle is a rap reality show where independent artists from across India compete with original music, battles and collaborations. Since 2019 it has run for five seasons, turned contestants into headliners, and brought desi hip hop to prime time television.

format.text: Rappers from across the country audition with original material. Season 1 picked a top 15, and later seasons start with 19 to 25 rappers before a first cut.

From season 2 onward, contestants join squads led by squad bosses. In the opening weeks Badshah assigns rappers to squads, but a squad boss can sound the horn (season 2), give a mic drop (seasons 3 and 5) or claim a rapper to pull them in.

Each week has a theme, from lyrical and imagery weeks to collabs, ad jingles and industry ready challenges. Squad bosses and judges score every performance, and the Squad of the Week earns a power card such as immunity, a save or a shuffle.
Low scorers land in the danger zone and face the public vote. The bottom rappers then fight to survive in battle rounds such as Battleground, Ground Shunya, BattleVerse or the 32-bar Challenge.
A ticket to the finale or the Rap Royalty title can skip the semi-final battles. The last five or six rappers perform in a two-night finale for the title, prize money and sponsor prizes.
From season 2 the show also names an OG Hustler, a separate honour for the contestant who best represents the spirit of the hustle. In season 3 it came with a Rs 5 lakh cash prize.

about: This season, also known as MTV Hustle 4: 'HIP HOP, DON'T STOP', premiered on 19 October 2024.

Raga joined as a new squad boss, and his squad Raga Ragers produced the winner.
Streamed on JioCinema. Contestants' performances were released episode by episode.

sections.title: Squad and performer of the week

blocks.text: MTV Hustle season 1 winner M-Zee Bella supported Lashcurry. MTV Hustle season 2 winner MC Square supported Naam Sujal. MTV Hustle season 3 winner Uday Pandhi supported Dharmik. Thus, who winner of Season 1 supported, occupied first position, similarly who winner of Season 2 supported, occupied second position and lastly, who winner of Season 3 supported, occupied third position. Appreciative arrangement for maintaining the winners' legacy.

During the fourth season, Rohan Cariappa, an internet personality known for covering the Indian hip hop scene, posted a video on 30 November 2024 pointing out that judge Ikka wore a Harley-Davidson jacket on the Royal Enfield sponsored show. His channel was soon hit with at least fifty copyright strikes on videos covering the show, and YouTube warned on 7 December that the channel could be shut down. The show faced a wide backlash, #ShameOnMTVHUSTLE trended on Twitter in support of Cariappa, and rappers including Yashraj, Encore ABJ, Badshah and Raja Kumari, along with YouTubers such as Samay Raina, Arpit Bala, RAPBOT and Prakhar Gupta, spoke out. Raftaar, a judge on the show, asked the audience to be patient and urged the makers to "meet in the middle and let's make it happen", and boAt, one of the sponsors, also voiced its disagreement. Cariappa later posted a written apology on Twitter on 6 December and an apology video the next day, thanking the audience, creators and rappers who backed him.

blocks.text: During Week 1, each contestant performed individually in front of the Squad Bosses. During a performance, the Squad Bosses could select a contestant by giving them a Mic Drop. A contestant needed to receive at least three Mic Drop votes from the Squad Bosses to become eligible for squad selection assigned by main judge Badshah, but the contestants who gets Playlisted from Badshah, they decide which squad to be assigned to.

Once a contestant is eligible, the Squad Bosses could use their Claim button to directly claim the contestant into their squad. Each Squad Boss could use the Claim button only once, and the first Squad Boss to press it successfully claimed the contestant for their squad.
32-bar Challenge
Seven contestants from 32-bars round battled it out in the Battleground, with only two making it to the next round.

From this week, the squad bosses & judge Badshah scored out of 10 after each performance. The squad with the highest score will be the Squad of the Week and get a Power Card. This week's squad of the week, EPR received Power Card of Immunity, which can be used on one of the Rappers next week.

The 2 winning squads' four rappers were immune and the contestants who gets Playlisted from Badshah will also be immune. The bottom two rappers from two losing squads were in the bottom and faced the public vote, with the votes effecting the next week's elimination. No elimination this week.
32-bar Challenge
Ansh4sure, Anushka, Farak and OG Tehran faced the public vote. Farak received the most votes and was saved from 32-bar Challenge.

The Squad of the Week, EPR, received the Shuffle Power Card. This power allows EPR to swap one rapper from any squad with another rapper from a different squad, with the shuffle taking effect the following week. The claimed rappers cannot be shuffled. Additionally, Badshah used his special power to save the bottom two rappers, resulting in no elimination this week.
EPR used the Shuffle Power Card to swap WhySoKai from Para Troopers with Dflacko from Agsy Alphas, with the swap taking effect immediately.
The Squad of the Week, MC Square, received the Shield Card. EPR used the Power Card of Immunity to save R-Mridul from the bottom.
32-bar Challenge
As there were only two rappers in the bottom, no public vote was held, and both were directly in the 32-Bar Challenge.

This week featured the Internal Squad Wars. The lowest-scoring rapper from each squad was placed in the bottom and battle against a Wild Card rapper. Squad Bosses were not eligible to score, only Badshah and guest judge Ikka scored each performance out of 10.
MC Square used the Shield Card to protect Farak from the bottom.

Last week's bottom four rappers competed against four wild-card rappers. The performances were judged by the four Squad Bosses and Badshah, with each awarding a score out of 10. The four rappers with the lowest total scores were eliminated from the competition.
SickLot was selected and joined EPR Rebels Squad.
From this week onward, public voting was open throughout the week, affecting the rappers in the bottom.
Rappers collaborated with another rappers.
